criterion: pyopenjtalk run_frontend reading of the target morpheme != benchmark gold (CP6 canon)

accent.source: benchmark has readings only; the accent in the tag is not part of what this set measures
accent.derivation: front-end run on the correct reading, then checked item by item by the author (native speaker) in scripts/eval/review_accents_server.py
fixed_2026-09-09: mora splitter counted a long vowel with the preceding kana while the accent index does not, so the nucleus sat one mora too far right on 69 of 344 marked items (拾 ジュー' -> ジュ'ー)
the router applied a registry entry to every occurrence; for evaluation it is limited to the item's own occurrence (registering 十 as トー otherwise fires on 十五 and 二十歳)
accent.phrase_scope: accent belongs to the accent phrase, so where a preceding modifier absorbs the target (その外 -> ソノ'ホカ) the review names the span and the tag wraps it
